established_findings.text: Building 1 was not affected by the incident.
Both generators are rated at 2 MW.
The utility provider was notified at 03:05 (stated in three places, consistently).
Generator B shut down at 04:10 and Generator A took the load.
A refuel truck was dispatched at 03:40.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: F1 says power was lost at 02:14 but F10 timeline shows the alarm at 02:41
F3 says service restored at 06:34 (4h20m outage per F4) but F15 says utility feed restored at 08:05
F5 says 312 customers affected but F19 says 213
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Billing or support records of affected accounts

unresolved_conflicts.summary: F6 says Priya Raman approved the failover but F12 says Daniel Okafor
F2 says the UPS carried the load for 15 minutes but F11 says 9 minutes (F17 is only the rating, not a conflict)
F18 says roughly 11 hours of runtime but F21 says 20 percent, about 3 hours
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Fuel vendor gauge reading vs Facilities estimate

unresolved_conflicts.summary: F7 says a storm triggered the fault but F23 says clear skies and F24 says a transformer failure at Substation 7
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Utility provider incident report; independent weather data

unresolved_conflicts.summary: F19 says 41 premium customers but F25 says 38
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Customer tier list for affected accounts

root_cause_statement: Not determined. The facts say the full root cause is under investigation; a storm and a transformer failure are both mentioned but the storm claim conflicts with the weather record.
not_supported_by_evidence: Whether any customer data was lost
Any SLA credit or financial penalty
Why Generator B shut down at 04:10
conclusion: Building 2 lost utility power on 14 March and Generator B then Generator A carried the load, but the report contradicts itself on start time, restoration time, customer counts, premium counts, who approved failover, UPS runtime, fuel level and cause. The root cause is not established. Most headline numbers cannot be trusted until the raw logs are checked.
